--- rough-ride hunt (copy this block unchanged) ---
rough-ride hunt | 6m19s | run 20261112-185717-hunt-048d | 6 confirmed, 1 dropped on re-run
target: http://localhost:3791

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. HIGH   Dashboard 'Recent waterings' shows 'No waterings yet' when the API returns a non-list
   where: / (Recent waterings, GET /api/waterings?limit=5)
   expected: An unexpected response shows an error, not the empty state
   saw: {"t2":"Recent waterings\nAll waterings\n\nNo waterings yet\n\nUse “Water now” on a bed to record one.\n\nGo to beds","pe":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185717-hunt-048d/probes/client-faults.mjs (expectation "dash-empty-object-not-empty-state")
2. MEDIUM Bed filter on Waterings page is lost on reload: page writes ?bed_id= to the URL but only reads ?bed=
   where: /waterings
   expected: After choosing a bed, reloading or sharing the URL (/waterings?bed_id=1) keeps the bed filter and shows only that bed's waterings
   saw: {"url":"/waterings?bed_id=1","select":"","text":["Waterings","Waterings","2 waterings, 14 L in total","Watering log","Waterings, most recent first","watering of Shade corner","watering of North bed"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185717-hunt-048d/probes/filter-url.mjs (expectation "filter-survives-reload")
3. MEDIUM Dashboard 'Recent waterings' renders rows of 'Never' for a malformed response
   where: / (Recent waterings)
   expected: A visible error when the response cannot be parsed
   saw: {"t3":"Recent waterings\nAll waterings\nThe five most recent waterings\nWHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–\nNever\t\t–","pe":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185717-hunt-048d/probes/client-faults.mjs (expectation "dash-malformed-shows-error")
4. MEDIUM Past watering form accepts 0.001 L and reports 'Recorded 0 L'
   where: /beds Record past watering form, POST /api/waterings
   expected: Amounts below the input's min of 0.1 L are refused, or the saved amount is shown truthfully
   saw: {"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 2 Nov 2026."],"created":[{"id":3,"bed_id":2,"bed_name":"Shade corner","watered_on":"2026-11-02","watered_at":null,"litres":0.001}]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185717-hunt-048d/probes/past-form-input.mjs (expectation "tiny-litres-refused-or-shown-correctly")
5. MEDIUM Past watering form accepts the year 1 as a date
   where: /beds Record past watering form, POST /api/waterings
   expected: An implausible date such as 0001-01-01 is refused with a reason
   saw: {"alerts":["Recorded 5 L on 1 Jan 1."],"created":[{"id":3,"bed_id":2,"bed_name":"Shade corner","watered_on":"0001-01-01","watered_at":null,"litres":5}]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185717-hunt-048d/probes/past-form-input.mjs (expectation "year-1-date-refused")
6. LOW    POST /api/waterings returns 500 for an oversized bed_id
   where: POST /api/waterings
   expected: A 4xx validation error for bed_id 99999999999999999999
   saw: {"status":500,"text":"Internal Server Error"}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-185717-hunt-048d/probes/race.mjs (expectation "huge-bed-id-not-5xx")

Dropped (did not reproduce):
- Waterings page crashes on a non-list response (waterings.value?.reduce is not a function): expectation "page-empty-object-not-success" held on re-run 1
